title: Todd Monken: I thanked Lamar Jackson, but told him I'll blitz him every third down

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken: I thanked Lamar Jackson, but told him I'll blitz him every third down
sources.description: Todd Monken's three seasons as the Ravens' offensive coordinator didn't result in a Super Bowl title, but his work in Baltimore was impressive enough to help land him the Browns' head coaching job this offseason.
